svg.title: Flying bird — hero camera, animated semantic vectors
svg.desc: Projected from CAM 02 • hero view in flying_bird_semantic.blend. Ten semantic layers, native cubic Bézier silhouettes and elliptical eyes, source ink palette, and an indefinitely repeating one-second loop. The seven poses of each wing retain their authored visibility switches. Contours include evaluated loft thickness and subdivision. Fill gradients abstract the rounded surfaces; camera-dependent paint order and masks keep embedded parts behind their hosts. No bitmap images or triangulated mesh geometry are embedded.

g.data-occlusion: Behind head for the entire hero-camera loop
